g.text: Geometric Symmetry: Exact mathematical centroid at (512, 512)
Halo cutouts punch background void, creating floating peer nodes
TORRENT CLIENT BY ASIAN DVD CLUB
SF Pro Display / Geometric Sans (Weight: 800 Bold, Letter-spacing: +8 to +14)
SF Pro Text / Inter / Segoe UI (Weights: 400 Regular, 500 Medium, 600 Semibold)
SF Pro Mono / JetBrains Mono (Hashes, Passkeys, Swarm IP, Rates)
• Use the master Nebulae Peer Constellation mark (icon-master.svg) as the single source of truth.
• Maintain the amber highlight (#F59E0B) strictly at the central peer node in full-color usage.
• Ensure high contrast between the Ivory mark (#F8FAFC) and Deep Space void (#10131D).
• Use the halo punch cutouts to keep peer nodes visually distinct from connecting strokes.
• Pair with clean geometric sans-serif typography (SF Pro / Inter) with generous uppercase tracking.
• Do NOT use AsianDVDClub website crests, discs, reels, or copied graphic assets.
• Do NOT use generic download arrows, globe maps, or green torrent-client brand styling.
• Do NOT alter stroke widths, node coordinates (316, 512, 708), or halo cutout radiuses.
• Do NOT add text inside the favicon or app-icon frame at any resolution.
• Do NOT add crowded peer meshes, literal detailed nebula clouds, or starfield clutter.
